name: Federal Reserve press releases
provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
rate_limits: None published for the RSS feed. We read it once an hour.
history_start: The feed holds the latest 20 releases; the website archive goes back to 1996.
what_it_has: Every Board press release: FOMC statements, minutes, bank approvals, enforcement actions and speeches, with title, link, time and a short description.
simple: The US central bank's own announcements, straight from its website.
license_terms: Public domain US government work: material may be copied and distributed without permission; credit the Board. https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm
quality_notes: Many releases are routine bank approvals, not market news. The feed starts with a byte order mark, which our parser handles.

relevance.reason: FOMC statements and minutes are among the biggest scheduled dollar events.

news_use.what_we_store: headline, link and a summary of at most 280 characters
news_use.terms_quote: may be copied and distributed without permission
